holdout_card.fact_statement: The World Health Organization dispatched 60 tonnes of critical medical supplies to Myanmar.
holdout_card.source_span: The World Health Organization announced a dispatch of 60 tonnes of critical medical supplies, including mobile medical tents, surgical kits and medicines.
